name: postgres
title: Server Postgres pool
description: lib/postgres.ts: one Postgres pool for the server-side blocks (outbox, jobs, webhook inbox, billing).
docs: The pool reads `SUPABASE_DB_URL`, then `DATABASE_URL`; the value above is the local stack from `supabase start`. Never import it from client code. See https://bettersupabase.com/docs/blocks/queue.
